reports.title: Fall Crappie on Missouri’s Stockton Lake
reports.text:
Guide Kris Nelson (right) and his customers know that Stockton Lake’s fall crappie fishing is something to smile about.
Fall Crappie on Missouri’s Stockton Lake
By Brent Frazee
Photos courtesy of Tandem Fly Outfitters
It’s hard to imagine that a 25,000-acre reservoir in the Missouri Ozarks is somewhat of a secret to crappie fishermen. But that’s the case with Stockton Lake, a clear-water gem in the southwest part of the state.
Fishermen flood to its neighbors, Truman Lake and Lake of the Ozarks, which are known nationally for their crappie fishing. Stockton, with its largely undeveloped shorelines, gets far less fishing pressure … and attention.
Fishermen don’t know what they’re missing…
